attributes.title: Alert Queue
attributes.description: Correlated alerts from security-alerts-*, one row per alert the engine produced, newest first. Open an alert in Discover to reach its supporting events. The alert's own reasoning text is deliberately not shown here: it states the findings, which would hand over the conclusion before any evidence was read.

attributes.description: Alert count by severity, from security-alerts-*. Severity is set by the correlation rule that fired.

attributes.title: SOC Triage Board
attributes.description: Alert triage for the lab dataset. The queue and the severity, timeline and per-host panels read security-alerts-*.
